newsitem.title: UK: BMW seeks aid for UK plant - report.
newsitem.headline: BMW seeks aid for UK plant - report.

text.p: Bayerische Motoren-Werke AG (BMW) and its Rover subsidiary are pressing the British government to help fund a 450 million stg engine factory that would mean thousands of jobs in the Midlands, the Sunday Times reported.

Ian Lang, the Board of Trade president, and Department of Trade and Industry officials will respond soon to the request. Top-level meetings with Rover's new chief executive Walter Hasselkus had taken place over the past month, the paper said.
BMW is expected to decide in the next few weeks whether to build the plant, which would employ 2,000 people and turn out 450,000 1.8- and 2.0-litre engines per year at full capacity.
